---
title: "1C Rename fields like B002922__Field_Description_That_Humans_Understand"
output: html_notebook
date: "2025-10-22"
---

``` {R Import libraries and set up variables}
# ---- Setup ----
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)

# Define paths (relative to notebook folder)
output_folder_path <- "output"
data_db_path <- file.path(output_folder_path, "census_data.sqlite")
vars_db_path <- file.path(output_folder_path, "census_variables.sqlite")

# ---- Connect to databases ----
conn_data <- dbConnect(SQLite(), data_db_path)
conn_vars <- dbConnect(SQLite(), vars_db_path)


```

``` {R Read data from SQLite DBs}

# ---- Read variable lookup ----
vars_df <- dbReadTable(conn_vars, "census_variables")

# Expecting columns: "name" (variable id) and "label" (human-readable label)
if (!all(c("name", "label") %in% colnames(vars_df))) {
  stop("The census_variables table must contain columns named 'name' and 'label'.")
}

# ---- Select your data table ----
# Replace 'census_data' with the actual table name in your census_data.sqlite
tables <- dbListTables(conn_data)
print(paste("Available tables in census_data.sqlite:", paste(tables, collapse = ", ")))
data_table <- tables[1]  # assumes first table if only one

# ---- Get current column names ----
col_info <- dbGetQuery(conn_data, paste0("PRAGMA table_info(", data_table, ");"))
current_cols <- col_info$name

# ---- Clean label text to form valid SQLite names ----
sanitize_name <- function(x) {
  # Replace spaces and punctuation with underscores
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", x)
  # Collapse multiple underscores
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  # Trim leading/trailing underscores
  x <- gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
  return(x)
}
```

``` {R Loop through columns and rename}
# ---- Loop through columns and rename ----
for (col in current_cols) {
  match_row <- vars_df %>% filter(name == col)
  if (nrow(match_row) == 1 && !is.na(match_row$label)) {
    new_name <- paste0(col, "__", sanitize_name(match_row$label))
    
    # Only rename if different
    if (new_name != col) {
      sql <- sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s RENAME COLUMN \"%s\" TO \"%s\";", data_table, col, new_name)
      cat("Renaming:", col, "→", new_name, "\n")
      dbExecute(conn_data, sql)
    }
  } else {
    cat("No label found for column:", col, "- skipping.\n")
  }
}
```

``` {R Finish up}
# ---- Done ----
cat("All matching columns have been renamed in place.\n")

# Disconnect
dbDisconnect(conn_data)
dbDisconnect(conn_vars)
```
